newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Surry nuke seen at full power Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Surry nuke seen at full power Tuesday.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's 781 megawatt Surry nuclear power unit 2 in Gravel Neck, Va. was expected to reach full output Tuesday afternoon after a reduction early in the day for repairs, a spokesman said.
"We expect to begin ramping up power about noon (1200 EDT) and should reach full power in about six hours," company spokesman Charles Taylor said Tuesday.
The unit is currently operating at about 35 percent of capacity after a reduction early Tuesday to replace an electronic relay, Taylor said.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources Inc.
